arguments.text: 8 km, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250, 2500, ...). Pacer sets effort from POD reserve. My jobs: (1) Instrument honesty: compare pod power vs heart rate vs GPS speed on paired out/back legs; if the share of pod power reaching the boat shifts with no weed and HR does not follow the pod, suspect pod drift and set pod_gain. (2) Weed/drag: watch local push drop within a leg (my metric push_drop); pacer clears rudder, I check the dip/recovery. (3) Radio course changes: set_race_distance + tell distance. (4) Critical power check mid-race from HR trend at steady power (HR flat below CP, climbing above). (5) Final 2 km: make sure pod reserve gets spent (pacer finish push only fires above 40 % reserve under 800 m). Keep cues few.

arguments.text: 8 km, legs 1250 m (turns at 1250, 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500). Pod looks honest (share 0.68 stable, HR flat ~165 at pod 167 W); boat-model reserve is wrong, ignore it. Paddler over-dramatises. Pacer has no push except the finish rule (>40 % pod reserve under 800 m), and test_cost says ~12 kJ would go unspent at current effort. PLAN: (a) after 2800 m (pacer ease rule off) run a CP test piece +10 % 240 s on leg 3, measure HR trend during last 2 min vs before: levelling -> CP higher than 170, climbing -> CP near 170. (b) Then use further pieces to spend the pod reserve evenly (target ~0 reserve at finish), keeping >40 % only if relying on pacer finish rule. (c) Keep watching weed/pod drift (push_drop watch) and radio messages.
